# Evaluation report (generated by scripts/run_eval.py, do not edit)

80 simulated incidents (10 fault types, 19 dev / 61 test) in the fictional Velmora Fresh grocery platform. Flags: {'decoy_change': 35, 'flapping': 36, 'silent_root': 21, 'injection': 10}; 69 incidents have no change record on the root service. An answer is fully correct when the root service, the fault type and the runbook action are all right. Rates show k/n and a Wilson 95% interval. LLM runs on CPU with 4-bit weights; times depend on machine load.

Alert noise (synthetic): 442 alerts, median 4.0 per incident (max 16); non-root share 83.9% (371/442, 80.2-87.1%); root alert fires first 38.8% (31/80, 28.8-49.7%); root never alerts 36.2% (29/80, 26.6-47.2%).
